products.name: MDM Migration Readiness Assessment & Wave Planning — Commercial
products.short_description: A vendor-neutral MDM migration readiness assessment and wave plan — inventory the estate, score readiness and risk, and produce a sequenced wave plan so the migration runs to a script instead of by surprise. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Know exactly what you're migrating — before you touch a single device

Most MDM migrations fail in planning, not execution: nobody has a clean inventory, the waves aren't thought through, and the risks surface mid-cutover. This solution is a vendor-neutral MDM migration readiness assessment and wave plan — inventory the current estate (devices, OS mix, apps, profiles, enrollment types), score readiness and risk, and produce a sequenced wave plan so the actual migration runs to a script instead of by surprise.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the readiness-assessment model, what to inventory (devices, OS/platform mix, apps, profiles, compliance, enrollment types, dependencies), readiness/risk scoring, and how the wave plan is built.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (read access to the current MDM, an inventory/export method, target-platform context, stakeholder input) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: inventory the estate, classify and score readiness/risk, identify dependencies and blockers, design sequenced waves with entry/exit criteria, produce the plan, then validate it against a pilot wave.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — estate inventory discovery, data-completeness validation, a readiness/risk and wave-plan report, safe remediation of inventory gaps, and a wave/cohort group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A clear-eyed picture of exactly what you're migrating and in what order — estate inventoried, readiness and risk scored, and a sequenced wave plan with entry/exit criteria — so the migration runs to a script, validated against a pilot wave before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • MDMRDY-Discovery.ps1 — build the estate inventory for an MDM migration (vendor-neutral)
    • MDMRDY-Remediation.ps1 — safely fill estate-inventory data gaps (default -WhatIf)
    • MDMRDY-Report.ps1 — readiness/risk scoring + dependency map + draft wave plan (read-only)
    • MDMRDY-Set-WaveCohortTargeting.ps1 — build the wave cohorts / cohort groups for the migration
    • MDMRDY-Validation.ps1 — check estate inventory data completeness before scoring

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
